summary: preinstall exfiltrates Lambda handler source and internal metadata to webhook.site
details: The package's preinstall script (probe.js) reads installer-side files under /var/task/handlers (specifically /var/task/handlers/ZN59c4b867df00bf010438ca741e31d5d3.js) and probes the AWS Lambda internal runtime API at 169.254.100.1, then POSTs the collected file contents and probe results to a hardcoded webhook.site endpoint (webhook.site/5711fe0a-6437-47ae-9fd0-75d624c26467/installer). The behavior fires automatically on npm install via scripts.preinstall. The package's self-description as an authorised bug-bounty research artifact does not change what the code does: installer-side source code and internal cloud metadata are exfiltrated to an author-controlled third-party webhook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
